audio.prompt: Instrumental looping game soundtrack for Pixel Tank Battle. Pixel arcade tank battle game. Top-down view. Player controls GREEN tank: WASD movement, mouse or arrow keys for aiming, spacebar to shoot. Enemies: light tank (fast, 1 hit point), medium tank (slow, 3 hit points, shoots back), heavy tank (very slow, 5 hit points, powerful shot). Map: destructible brick walls, indestructible metal blocks, bushes for hiding (enemies shoot through). Powerups on map: star (rapid fire), helmet (shield 5 sec), bomb (explodes all enemies on screen). Enemy waves increase in difficulty. On enemy destruction: animated pixel explosion. All drawn with pixel blocks via canvas: tanks 32x32, walls 16x16, animated explosions. Colors: green player, grey enemies, brown walls, yellow explosions. HUD: lives top left, score center, wave number top right. Music from menu. Pause with ESC key shows 'Back to Menu' button. Russian UI. Full responsive.. Theme retro. Energetic, polished, suitable for browser arcade gameplay, no vocals.
